From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proof-of-Value sprint — acceptance criteria, owners, and weekly cadence

Hi Lucy —

Thanks again for a great conversation today. Quick recap and my proposed runbook so we keep momentum toward a short Proof-of-Value (PoV) sprint:

Summary of discovery (from our call)
- Primary goal: validate LLM-assisted triage for claims intake to reduce manual routing by 40% and decrease average handling time.
- Key constraints: PHI-safe handling, on-prem connector for EHR metadata, 3rd-party validation for clinical labels.

Proposed success criteria (suggested)
- Routing accuracy >= 85% on the seeded evaluation set (per-scenario precision/recall).
- Mean time to first suggestion < 2s for 95th percentile during peak traffic tests.
- No PHI leakage in a random sample audit (zero findings preferred).

4-week PoV sprint (high level)
Week 0 (prep): provisioning, SOC2 summary & network allowlist, dataset ingestion template.
Week 1: integration + dry-run on masked data; baseline metrics captured.
Week 2: model tuning & acceptance runs on held-out set.
Week 3: robustness tests, latency/load validation, user acceptance sampling.
Week 4: final acceptance, handoff doc, and go/no-go decision.

Ownership (proposed)
- Atlas: provide masked sample dataset (labels) and procurement/PO contact.
- Redwood: infra provisioning, model variant selection, evaluation rubric, and runbook.
- Atlas clinical SME: labeling clarifications and acceptance sign-off.

Attachments I’m sending: pov-success-rubric.xlsx (rubric + metrics), mutual-action-plan.pdf (timeline + owners).

Next steps (please):
1) Confirm the acceptance metrics above (accuracy/latency/PHI audit) or propose edits.
2) Share the procurement contact for license/PO coordination.
3) Tentative kickoff: Tue Oct 27 or Wed Oct 28 — which works for your team?

I’ll loop in engineering and security once you confirm.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128
